Judging by their Facebook posts, the cast and crew of SPN are super excited to be in filming for season 11. While it did seem like the show was going downhill for a while, the finale of season 10 really piqued my interest and left me with many questions. I'm curious as to what you guys think about what's happened so far and what might be come up.

  1. Did they really kill Death, and if so what does this mean for the world? Are the dead going to come back to life? Is it going to be like in that episode where the Reaper was kidnapped and people just didn't die at all? If the dead do come back to life, then what does that mean for all of demon-kind? What about all of the monsters that have been killed by hunters? Do they just come back out of purgatory?

  2. What do you think this primordial evil that existed before God is? Does this mean there's going to be an ultimate battle between God and evil again in which one of the Winchester brothers is going to have to kill the other and take on the mark of Cain again in order to seal it away, or do you think they'll find a way to do away with whatever this black mist turns out to be?

  3. Rowena, much as I disliked her as a character, now has the spell book. What kind of havoc do you think she is going to wreak with this ultimate evil now unleashed into the world?

Give me your two cents and feel free to bring up any other thoughts or questions about the direction we're heading for season 11!
[Spoilers All] Too quiet in here, let's speculate and bring some life back into this 'verse.

1. I don't think Death is really dead; they probably just killed his current corporeal form. It wouldn't surprise me if he just temporarily ended up in purgatory and busts out (and probably extremely pissed). Or maybe he'll be able to rally some of the beings there to fight against the "Darkness" in a LotR way.

  2. The original evil I'm not too sure about. It thrived in the darkness before god. It'd be kinda cool though if they looked and acted like "The Darkness" being from the comic book/game series; possessing beings and making them forces of natures. The Darkness II Trailer . The season will probably end with a way to remove the Mark of Cain, but I hope it requires something crazy like a sacrifice of Lucifer and Michael.

  3. I think she'll start off doing everything and anything she wants, but will eventually find the darkness impeding and closing in on her. She'll have to return to the Winchesters and join the struggle. That or she'll be consumed by The Darkness and made the face of the enemy like Kerrigan was in Starcraft when she became Queen.

I don't think death is dead. Not sure how they are going to bring him back, but I love the guy who played him. I also liked Rowena and thought that whole idea of Crowley's mom was awesome. It is like he is becoming more human still. As for the darkness, just the name itself gives me the creeps so its going to be awesome.

What I am excited to see is "god" come back, as we did get a sneak peek of him, and are they ever going to bust their little brother out of hell? I feel like they alluded to both of these in the past season and I hope they are addressed.
